Initial release: Combines the PARA organizational method with Proactive Agent Architecture for a unified content and AI workspace.

- Provides a ready-to-use directory template based on PARA (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) for organized content management.
- Integrates Proactive Agent memory structure, including daily logs, active session state, error/learning logs, and agent/user configuration.
- Outlines best practices and workflows for capturing, sorting, reviewing, and distilling information.
- Documents recommended review cycles (daily, weekly, monthly) for optimal maintenance.
- Offers clear installation and integration instructions.
- Licensed under MIT for open, flexible use.
